item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: ilo li moku e telo tan poki monsi sina li weka e wile telo
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: o ken e telo pi lipu ni (o kepeken poki telo tawa telo pi poki suli)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: o ken ala e telo pi lipu ni (o kepeken poki telo tawa telo pi poki suli)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: wile telo li lon la o moku telo
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: ken kepeken e kipisi suli anu kipisi sama tu pi pona telo la o moku telo
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: ken kepeken e pona telo ale la o moku telo
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_pure_o: o kepeken telo pi jaki ala taso
